CustomField.description: Derives the tenant name from Contact for Individual tenancies or Account for Company tenancies; if Type is blank, it uses whichever relationship is populated.
CustomField.formula:
IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Type__c)),
IF(AND(ISBLANK(Account__c),NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c))), Contact__r.FirstName & ' ' & Contact__r.LastName , IF(AND(ISBLANK(Contact__c),NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c))), Account__r.Name, '' ) )
, IF(AND(TEXT(Type__c) = 'Individual', NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c))), Contact__r.FirstName & ' ' & Contact__r.LastName ,
IF(AND(TEXT(Type__c) = 'Company', NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c))), Account__r.Name, '' )
) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows the related Contact or Account name selected according to the tenancy type.
CustomField.label: Tenant Name
